# Fixtures where a Python hook is deliberately stricter than its bash
# original (see plugins/wiki/scripts/hookjson.py). One per line:
#   <dir>/<case> stricter   bash lets it through (exit 0), Python blocks
#   <dir>/<case> message    both block, with different messages
#   <dir>/<case> locale     bash's result depends on the locale; only
#                           Python's is checked
# guard.py's other deliberate differences are cases in run-tests.sh (gcase).
# run-tests.sh checks each version against this list, and the rest for
# identical exit codes and messages.
block-push/block-unicode-escape-push stricter
block-push/block-truncated-json stricter
block-push/block-top-level-array stricter
block-push/block-non-string-command message
